title: OTWD seed source registry
description: The format of seed-sources.json, the registry of external open datasets OTWD imports or plans to import, and of each entry served by GET /v1/seed-sources, which adds the latest sync. Every seed source reference in provenance and every seed source credit in an attribution list copies its licence, attribution and changes from here. A seed source is never imported until its licence review is confirmed.

dataset_name.description: The dataset's name as its publisher gives it.

attribution.description: The credit text shown for facts from this source, as an AttributionEntry's text.

attribution_notes.description: Anything else the licensor asks for in a credit, quoted from the publisher's record, such as a notice that the publisher created and owns the data.

changes.description: The changes OTWD makes to the data on import, as the licence asks a reuser to indicate.

dataset_url.description: The publisher's own record for the dataset, where its licence is stated.

record_types.description: The record types the source seeds.

subdivisions.description: The subdivisions the source covers, when it covers less than a country.

status.description: candidate: the licence reads as compatible and the source is planned, nothing imported. active: imported and re-synced on its schedule. blocked: not imported until the question in its licence review is answered. retired: no longer imported, and facts it supplied keep their provenance. The same statuses as docs/seed-sources.md. Open: a reader treats a status it does not know as retired.

licence_review.description: Whether a maintainer has confirmed, from the publisher's own record, the licence, the attribution it requires and that it is compatible with publishing under CC BY 4.0. An active source has a confirmed review.

allOf.description: A source under a CC BY licence links the licence and states the changes OTWD makes, as AttributionEntry requires.
